recipes.title: Greek spinach and egg pita pockets, light
recipes.summary: Warm pita pockets filled with softly scrambled eggs, spinach, onion and lemon-dill yogurt. Extra greens and less bread and oil keep this Greek breakfast lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the spinach, onion, cucumber, garlic and dill weed in their listed forms.
Stir the greek yogurt, cucumber, lemon juice, dill weed and half the salt together.
Heat the olive oil in a wide frying pan.
Cook the onion until soft and lightly golden.
Stir the garlic into the onion until fragrant.
Fold the spinach into the pan until wilted and fairly dry.
Beat the eggs with the remaining salt.
Fold the eggs through the spinach until softly set.
Warm the pita bread in a dry frying pan until flexible.
Fill the pita bread with the eggs and greek yogurt mixture.

recipes.storageNotes: Best assembled just before serving. Refrigerate the egg filling and yogurt separately for up to 2 days. Reheat the eggs gently and warm the pita bread fresh. Do not freeze.

recipes.title: Mexican chicken and black bean flautas, light
recipes.summary: Crisp baked flautas filled with chicken, black beans, peppers and tomato, served with lime yogurt and cilantro. Less tortilla and oil keep this Mexican lunch lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prepare the chicken breast, bell pepper, onion, garlic, lime and cilantro in their listed forms.
Heat half the olive oil in a wide frying pan.
Brown the chicken breast until nearly cooked through.
Cook the onion and bell pepper until soft and lightly browned.
Stir the garlic, cumin, paprika and half the salt into the pan.
Add the tomatoes, canned, and black beans.
Simmer the filling until thick and spoonable.
Fold the chicken breast through the black beans.
Divide the chicken breast filling among the tortilla.
Roll each tortilla tightly around the filling.
Brush the flautas with the remaining olive oil.
Bake the flautas until crisp and golden.
Stir the greek yogurt, lime and remaining salt together.
Finish the Mexican chicken and black bean flautas with the greek yogurt and cilantro.

recipes.storageNotes: Best served freshly baked. Refrigerate the flautas and yogurt separately for up to 3 days. Reheat the flautas in a hot oven until crisp. Freeze baked flautas for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Indian chicken saag with potatoes, light
recipes.summary: Tender chicken and potatoes in a vivid spinach, tomato, ginger and cumin sauce. Extra spinach and less oil keep this Indian dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken thigh, potato, spinach, onion, garlic, ginger and cilantro in their listed forms.
Wilt the spinach in a large saucepan until tender.
Blend the spinach with the vegetable broth until smooth.
Heat the vegetable oil in the saucepan.
Cook the onion until soft and golden.
Brown the chicken thigh on several sides.
Stir the garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika and salt into the chicken thigh.
Add the tomatoes, canned, and potato.
Simmer the covered chicken and potato until nearly tender.
Pour the blended spinach into the saucepan.
Simmer the chicken saag until the thigh and potato are tender.
Stir the lemon juice into the Indian chicken saag.
Finish the chicken saag with the cilantro.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 3 days and reheat gently until the chicken is steaming. Freeze the chicken saag for up to 2 months; thaw overnight before reheating.

recipes.title: Italian eggplant parmesan bites, light
recipes.summary: Baked eggplant rounds topped with tomato, basil and parmesan over a crisp bread coating. Less cheese and oil keep this Italian snack lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prepare the eggplant, bread, garlic, basil and parmesan cheese in their listed forms.
Pulse the bread in a food processor until coarse crumbs form.
Mix half the parmesan cheese with the bread crumbs.
Beat the eggs with half the salt.
Dip each eggplant round into the eggs.
Coat each eggplant round with the bread and parmesan cheese mixture.
Brush the coated eggplant with the olive oil.
Bake the eggplant rounds until tender and crisp at the edges.
Stir the tomatoes, canned, tomato paste, garlic and remaining salt together.
Simmer the tomato sauce until thick and spoonable.
Spoon the tomato sauce over the baked eggplant.
Scatter the remaining parmesan cheese over the eggplant bites.
Bake until the parmesan cheese is melted and golden.
Finish the Italian eggplant parmesan bites with the basil.

recipes.storageNotes: Best served hot and crisp. Refrigerate for up to 2 days and reheat in a hot oven. Freeze the baked bites for up to 1 month, then reheat from thawed.

recipes.title: Japanese grilled salmon rice balls, light
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged Japanese rice balls filled with soy-ginger salmon and spring onions, served with cool cucumber. Less rice and oil keep breakfast lighter.

steps.instruction: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Cook the white rice until tender and fully steamed.
Prepare the cucumber, spring onions and ginger in their listed forms.
Stir the soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar and ginger together.
Brush the salmon with part of the soy sauce mixture.
Cook the salmon in a covered frying pan until opaque and flaky.
Flake the salmon into small pieces.
Mix the salmon with the spring onions, sesame seeds and half the remaining soy sauce mixture.
Cool the white rice until comfortable to handle.
Mix the salt through the white rice.
Shape the white rice around the salmon filling.
Brush the rice balls with the remaining soy sauce mixture.
Heat the sesame oil in a wide non-stick frying pan.
Grill the rice balls until crisp and golden on both flat sides.
Serve the Japanese grilled salmon rice balls with the cucumber.

recipes.storageNotes: Best served freshly grilled. Refrigerate for up to 2 days and reheat in a covered pan, then uncover to crisp. Freeze formed rice balls for up to 1 month.
